{@code allowEmptyShould(true)}: the {@code identity} and {@code incident} layers are still empty in RIT-US-01; the rules apply as soon as classes appear.

name: com.itsm.resolveit.testsupport.AuthorizationMatrix
comment:
Reusable authorisation test harness (RIT-US-05): logs in one dev-seed user per role and checks the expected HTTP status of an endpoint for each role, plus for an anonymous caller.

Use it in an integration test that loads the dev seed ({@code spring.flyway.locations=classpath:db/migration,classpath:db/dev-seed}): 

{@code
 new AuthorizationMatrix(port).endpoint("GET", "/api/v1/users")
 .expect(Role.ADMIN, 200).expect(Role.SUPPORT_AGENT, 403).expect(Role.EMPLOYEE, 403)
 .expectAnonymous(401).verify();
 }
State-changing requests are sent with the CSRF token, so the check is about the role only.

methods.name: verify
methods.comment: Sends the request once per role (and anonymously) and asserts every status.
